question: "_________ is the writer of the book 'India Wins Freedom'."
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maulana **Abul Kalam Azad.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ‘India Wins freedom’ is a book written by Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, who remained Congress President for almost 6 yrs (1940 - 46).
 
• This was a critical 2nd world war period and very crucial from the Indian freedom movement perspective.
 
• During this period he was in key decision-making and negotiating role with the Britishers.
 
• India Wins Freedom is an enlightening account of the partition from the author, Maulana Azad's perspective.
 
• It includes his personal experiences when India became independent and his ideas on freedom and liberty.
